about: T-509 held-out set. Every report of one firm, fixed on 2026-11-18 before any report was read. The converter and the numbers were built on the design set only; these reports were only run through the same script. A later task that changes the form or the converter must not read these reports or tune on their results; it reruns measure.mjs and reports the held-out numbers as they come.

second.about: T-534 second held-out set (sources.json, set heldout-2), because the first firm's public reports are summaries with no findings. The firm was chosen by the rule in docs/tasks/T-534-form-revision.md, committed before any of its reports was opened; its layout (layouts/shieldify.json) was written from the set layout-2 only. These six were hashed and run through measure.mjs once, on version 2 of the form, and never read. The same rule as above binds every later task.
